inputs.description: A short title or headline for the idea.
inputs.label: Title

inputs.description: The main body of the idea.

inputs.description: Public URLs of images to attach to the idea.

inputs.description: Mark this idea as created with AI assistance.

operations.name: Create Idea

operations.description: Create a post in Buffer and add it to the queue, share it next, share it now, or schedule it for a custom time. Each run also loads your channel list (one extra Buffer API request, counted against your plan limit; Free: 600 a day).

inputs.description: The text content of the post.
inputs.label: Text
inputs.name: text

inputs.description: When and how the post should be published.
inputs.label: Share Mode
inputs.name: mode

inputs.description: When to publish the post. Required when Share Mode is "Schedule for Custom Time". ISO 8601 (UTC).
inputs.label: Scheduled Time
inputs.name: dueAt

inputs.description: Use "Automatic" for channels Buffer can publish to directly. Use "Notification" for channels that require manual publishing via the Buffer mobile app (e.g. Instagram personal accounts).
inputs.label: Scheduling Type
inputs.name: schedulingType

inputs.description: Save the post as a draft instead of scheduling it. Drafts are not published until explicitly scheduled.
inputs.label: Save as Draft
inputs.name: saveToDraft

inputs.description: Public URLs of images to attach to the post.
inputs.label: Image URLs
inputs.name: imageUrls

inputs.description: A link to share. On Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Substack it becomes a link preview card when no images are attached; otherwise it is added to the end of the text.
inputs.label: Link URL
inputs.name: linkUrl

inputs.description: The video title. Required when a YouTube channel is selected; ignored for other channels.
inputs.label: YouTube Title
inputs.name: youtubeTitle

inputs.description: The video category. Required when a YouTube channel is selected; ignored for other channels.
inputs.label: YouTube Category
inputs.name: youtubeCategoryId

operations.name: Create Post

operations.description: Triggers when a new channel is connected to your Buffer organization. Each check uses one Buffer API request, which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
operations.name: New Channel

operations.description: Triggers when a new post is queued in Buffer. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 matching posts, at most 10 per check; any left over are picked up on the next check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
operations.name: New Queue Item

operations.description: Triggers when a Buffer post is successfully published. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 posts sent in the last 24 hours, at most 10 per check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day). If more than 1,000 posts are sent in one day, only the 1,000 with the latest scheduled times are checked.
operations.name: New Sent Post
